name: gns3-mcp
description: GNS3 lab automation with AI agent
long_description: GNS3 v3 lab automation MCP server with 15 CRUD-style tools. Create/modify nodes (RAM, CPUs, QEMU disks, CD-ROM, options), wire links, configure devices via console/SSH, topology management, real-time notifications. Dependencies are installed by Claude Desktop with uv on first start.

gns3_host.title: GNS3 Server Host
gns3_host.description: GNS3 server hostname or IP address

tools.name: gns3_connection
tools.description: CRUD: Manage GNS3 server connection (check status, retry auth, full reconnect with session cleanup). Actions: check, retry, reconnect

tools.name: project
tools.description: CRUD: Manage GNS3 projects (list, open, create, close). Actions: list, open, create, close

tools.name: node
tools.description: CRUD: Manage nodes (list, create, delete, set properties/state). Supports wildcards ('*', 'Router*'), JSON arrays, parallel execution. Actions: list, create, delete, set

tools.name: link
tools.description: CRUD: Manage network connections (list, batch connect/disconnect). Two-phase validation. Actions: list, batch

tools.name: node_file
tools.description: CRUD: Docker node file operations (read, write, configure network). Auto-restarts node for network config. Actions: read, write, configure_network

tools.name: project_docs
tools.description: CRUD: Project documentation (get/update README). Store IP schemes, credentials, architecture notes. Actions: get, update

tools.name: drawing
tools.description: CRUD: Topology drawings (list, create, update, delete, batch). Shapes: rectangle, ellipse, line, text. Actions: list, create, update, delete, batch

tools.name: console
tools.description: Batch console operations (send, read, send_and_wait, keystroke). v0.53.0: Enhanced keystroke (space, repeat, pattern-based, sequences) + pagination handling (--More--). Operations: send, read, send_and_wait, keystroke

tools.name: ssh
tools.description: Batch SSH operations (configure, command, read, disconnect). Multi-proxy support, auto-recovery (30min TTL). Operations: configure, command, read, disconnect

tools.name: tftp
tools.description: TFTP server on the SSH proxy (list, upload, download, delete, status) for device config and firmware transfers

tools.name: http_client
tools.description: HTTP(S) GET requests and reachability checks to lab device APIs through the SSH proxy (get, status)

tools.name: notification
tools.description: GNS3 event notifications (subscribe, read, unsubscribe, status). Real-time node/link/log events via streaming API. Actions: subscribe, read, unsubscribe, status

tools.name: query_resource
tools.description: Universal resource query tool - access any MCP resource by URI pattern (projects://, nodes://, sessions://, etc.)

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Tool discovery - search/filter tools by category (project, node, console, ssh), capability (CRUD, batch, wildcard, parallel), or resource URI

tools.name: export_topology_diagram
tools.description: Export topology diagram as SVG/PNG with optional crop region

prompts.name: ssh_setup
prompts.description: SSH Setup Workflow - Device-specific instructions for configuring SSH on network devices (Cisco IOS, NX-OS, MikroTik, Juniper, Arista, Linux)
prompts.text: Device-specific SSH configuration workflow for Cisco IOS, NX-OS, MikroTik, Juniper, Arista, and Linux devices

prompts.name: topology_discovery
prompts.description: Topology Discovery Workflow - Discover and visualize network topology using MCP resources and tools
prompts.text: Guided workflow for discovering and visualizing network topology using MCP resources and export tools

prompts.name: troubleshooting
prompts.description: Network Troubleshooting Workflow - OSI model-based systematic troubleshooting for network labs
prompts.text: OSI model-based systematic troubleshooting methodology for network lab issues

prompts.name: lab_setup
prompts.description: Lab Setup Workflow - Automated lab topology creation with 6 topology types (star, mesh, linear, ring, OSPF, BGP)
prompts.text: Automated lab topology creation supporting star, mesh, linear, ring, OSPF, and BGP topologies

prompts.name: node_setup
prompts.description: Node Setup Workflow - Complete workflow for adding a new node to a lab (create, configure IP, document in README, establish SSH)
prompts.text: Complete workflow covering: create node from template, start and wait for boot, configure IP address via console, document IP/credentials in project README, and establish SSH session for automation. Supports Cisco IOS, Linux, and MikroTik with device-specific configuration commands.
